suggestion_body: Organize your stack into strategic clusters: Backend & Languages, Databases & Storage, DevOps & Cloud, and Frontend & UI. Placing Backend and DevOps first ensures automated ATS screeners immediately detect your technical domain.

suggestion_title: 1-Column Format: Zero Column Tags or Splitting
suggestion_body: In 1-column ATS mode, remove any left/right tags or layout divisions. ATS parsers read in a single vertical stream; divided elements trigger severe parsing penalties due to text scrambling risk.

suggestion_title: Canonical ATS Hierarchy: Skills Directly After Summary
suggestion_body: In 1-column ATS-optimized resumes, place Technical Skills before Work Experience to capture 80% of vacancy keyword matches within the first 200 tokens.

suggestion_title: Google XYZ Formula: Action Verb + Measurable Impact
suggestion_body: Structure each achievement as 'Accomplished [X], measured by [Y], by doing [Z]' (e.g. 'Optimized database query performance via execution plan profiling and indexing'). Avoid passive duty lists.

suggestion_title: Clean Repository Links & Explicit Tech Stack
suggestion_body: Include verifiable links to GitHub repositories or live demos with their explicit tech stack (e.g. React, Laravel, REST APIs). Technical screeners prioritize verifiable code.

suggestion_title: Standardized Degree Equivalency for ATS Filters
suggestion_body: Clarify international degree equivalencies (e.g., 'Associate Degree in Computer Programming' or 'B.S. in Computer Science & Engineering') with explicit graduation status to pass automated education filters.
Present Email, Phone, Location, and LinkedIn/GitHub URLs in selectable plain text without graphic icons or tables that block ATS OCR extraction.

suggestion_title: ATS Technical Syntax: Avoid Dollar Symbols ($N+1, $CI/CD)
suggestion_body: Do not use dollar symbols ($) to enclose technical terms or expressions (e.g. '$N+1$', '$CI/CD$'). ATS parsers (Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse) interpret '$' signs as compensation figures or broken regex variables, failing keyword matching.

suggestion_title: URL Integrity: Eliminate Spaces and Temporary Preview Builds
suggestion_body: Ensure no URLs contain accidental whitespace, and always point to canonical domains or production repositories rather than temporary deploy preview URLs ('deploy-preview-4...'). ATS crawlers reject links broken by whitespace.

suggestion_title: Glyph Overload: Eliminate Checkboxes (☑) and Non-Standard Symbols
suggestion_body: Suppress checkboxes (☑, ☐), decorative checkmarks (✓), or non-standard bullet symbols. ATS OCR and text layer extractors convert these into replacement characters ('?', '\uFFFD') or drop the entire bullet row.

suggestion_title: Skills Taxonomy: Canonical Technology Casing (JavaScript, MySQL)
suggestion_body: Format technologies with canonical industry casing (e.g., 'JavaScript' instead of 'Javascript', 'MySQL' instead of 'mysql', 'PostgreSQL', 'Docker'). ATS taxonomy ontologies (Lightcast, O*NET) match canonical casing for scoring.
